correctness.rationale: Rebuilt the three affine postcritical interval states, density normalization h=(Q,1+b,1)/(bD) across lengths b,b²,b³, and the row-stochastic transition R=[[1,b,b²]/Q,[1,0,0],[0,1,0]]. Cylinder-affine inverse branches give the binary order-two factor on states 00/01/10 and forbid 111 for every length; state R matrix has its nontrivial quadratic roots complex, modulus b/sqrt(Q), implying exponentially decaying sign-changing correlations. Independent exact SymPy reconstruction verified stationary digit mean b(1+2b)/D, C1=−b³(b+2)/D², two-step covariance recurrence, variance σ²=bQ(1+4b+b²)/D³ and its derivative −H(b)/D⁴. Descartes one-sign-change and endpoint signs prove one positive critical root in (0,1); finite irreducible aperiodic Markov-chain CLT justifies Gaussian fluctuations. Finite symbolic tests did not replace the all-cylinder Markov proof.

value.rationale: The natural second-level postcritical digit process reveals a qualitative shift from real one-step memory to damped oscillatory order-two memory. A complete rational covariance/variance law, strict dependence deficit and exact unique fluctuation optimizer are motivated statistical invariants of this expanding dynamical system, beyond invariant density alone.

final_claim: On q1=1/b, q0=1+b+b² for 0<b<1, the absolutely continuous stationary greedy binary digits have an exact genuine second-order three-state Markov description with no 111, oscillatory decaying two-mode covariances, exact partial-sum CLT variance σ²=b(1+b+b²)(1+4b+b²)/(1+2b+3b²)^3 strictly below the Bernoulli benchmark, and a unique variance maximum at b≈0.340712206148.
